title: RSO Resources (Campus Activities)
text:
RSO Resources (Campus Activities)

Space requests: RSOs in good standing can request space on campus, including the Ronald Tutor Campus Center, outdoor venues, and classrooms, if available. Requests must follow the social event policies in the Student Handbook. Submit space reservations through the Trojan Event Services website (trojanevents.usc.edu/venues/). Direct questions about Trojan Event Services spaces to scevents@usc.edu. Classroom requests use the Classroom Scheduling form and are accepted starting Week 4.

Sales and fundraising: RSOs and their members may not operate as businesses, generate income for individuals or businesses, or act as agents for outside entities. RSOs may fundraise for their own organization, another RSO, or an outside philanthropic agency or relief effort. Groups that exist only to support an outside philanthropic organization will not be recognized. No individual may receive money, trade, discounts, or other benefits from these activities. Fundraising events require a USC Events Permit Application (UEPA) and a meeting with Campus Activities at least two weeks in advance for approval.

Funding and banking: RSOs in good standing can open a USC Credit Union account for their organization. Forms are available for a New Account Package and for changing authorized signers.

Merchandise: The Trademarks and Licensing Services site lists authorized vendors for RSO merchandise.

Other resources: EngageSC tips are on the 'How to Navigate Engage' page (engage.usc.edu). Hazing prevention resources cover hazing prevention and healthy team bonding. Trojans Care for Trojans (TC4T) is a private, anonymous form for reporting concern about a fellow Trojan facing personal difficulties, run by the Office of Campus Wellbeing and Crisis Intervention. Report & Response accepts concerns openly or anonymously. RSOs can notify the Department of Public Safety (DPS) about upcoming off-campus parties through the DPS Party Notification Form; the form does not relieve hosts of responsibility to attendees or neighbors.

Campus Activities office: Steven & Kathryn Sample Hall (SKS) 410, 3607 Trousdale Parkway, Los Angeles, CA 90089. Phone: 213-740-5649. Email: campact@usc.edu (the page's mailto link lists stuacts@usc.edu; verify). Hours: Monday through Friday, 9:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m.
